title: Beta features
description: Every feature that is still being proven. Switch one on here; if it is wired at startup, restart from the same card to apply it.

banner.title: {{name}} is a beta feature
banner.bodyRestart: Turn it on, then restart to apply it.
banner.unknown: That feature is not known to this server.

toggle.label: Turn on {{name}}
toggle.lockedByEnv: Turned on by the server setting, so it cannot be switched off here.

readOnly: Only an administrator can switch beta features.

restart.needed: Saved. Restart to apply this change. Deploys and log streams in progress are interrupted and resume afterwards.
restart.unsupported: This install cannot restart itself because no process supervisor was detected. Restart the control plane, then re-check.
restart.askAdmin: Saved. An administrator needs to restart the control plane to apply it.

options.open: Use the CLI or server config instead
options.title: Turn on {{name}} another way
options.description: The switch on the card does the same thing. Use these if you prefer the command line or manage the server by config.
options.restartNote: This feature is wired when the server starts, so a restart applies it.

profile.title: Server profile
profile.description: Decides which optional parts of the server start. Moving between profiles never deletes data. Most of it is wired at startup, so a restart applies a change.

summary.minimal: One server as light as it gets. Nothing runs that you did not ask for.
summary.standard: The default install. Everything a small team needs.
summary.suite: Standard plus the mesh, plugins and every experimental feature.

facts.retention: Metrics and logs kept for {{days}} days
facts.loopbackAgent: Agent listener on loopback until a node enrolls
facts.lazyLoops: Backup loops start when a backup is scheduled
facts.recommendations: Backup and key rotation shown as recommendations, not score items

profile.recommended: This machine has little memory. The {{name}} profile is the lightest fit.
profile.pinnedHelp: {{env}} is set on the server, so it decides the profile. Remove it there to choose from this page.
profile.neverDeletes: Moving down stops loops and hides routes but never deletes rows. Moves that would orphan enrolled nodes or enabled plugins are refused.
profile.readOnly: Only an administrator can change the server profile.
